content: Russian STT: Yandex SpeechKit trained on large RU corpus, supports custom vocabulary / domain language models to boost recognition of jargon and numerals; good on short phrases and numerals. Whisper (OpenAI / self-host) strong general WER but no easy domain-term biasing and no RU-tuned vocabulary hooks; large model needed for good RU. Domain terms (инв.№, борт.камень, ЭВ №3, service names) will be mis-transcribed without a custom vocab / post-transcription normalization pass. STT output should feed the same alias/normalization layer as pasted text, not go straight to extraction.
